description: Raw engine failure text -> error class and retry kind. Classes: botCheck, ageRestricted, signInRequired, rateLimited, regionBlocked, notStarted, removed, unavailable, unsupported, drm, formatUnavailable, extractorBroken, forbidden, diskFull, permission, processorMissing, processing, cookiesUnreadable, network, unknown. Retry kinds: permanent, retryable, engine (refresh the engine first), rateLimited, botCheck. Wording is never compared; every case also fails if the user-facing message names an external tool.

cases.name: http 403 (desktop)
cases.reason: Desktop updates the engine daily on its own, so a 403 is a plain backoff retry.

input.text: ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden

cases.name: http 403 (android)
cases.reason: Android ships a bundled engine that can be stale, so a 403 refreshes it before retrying.
